description: React component for displaying network resource details including headers, payload, and response content within a trace viewer UI. It manages state for selected tabs, fetches request/response bodies, and renders various subcomponents like expandable sections, code viewers, and copy buttons.

methods.name: statusClass
methods.description: Returns a CSS class name based on HTTP status code for styling status indicator.

methods.name: formatBody
methods.description: Formats the response body string based on content type, attempting JSON pretty-printing or URL decoding as appropriate.
